items.title: Coherent Now Sees Growth Above 60% and Its First $4 Billion Quarter by Fiscal 2028
items.summary: Coherent has billions in AI contracts and a rival that is about to be swallowed whole. The harder question is whether the cash it burns building capacity will pay off before the biggest orders arrive.

items.title: Marvell’s $115 Billion Deal Has Lost More Than a Third of Its Value
items.summary: Analysts see Marvell doubling, yet the market is pricing something very different. A fixed exchange ratio with no safety net has turned a premium into a discount, and Lumentum investors are the first to show they doubt the deal.

items.title: Coherent Shares Rise 4% as AI Data Centre Demand Lifts Quarterly Revenue Nearly 50%
items.summary: Coherent Corp. (NYSE:COHR) shares gained approximately 4% in premarket trading on Thursday after the photonics company reported higher first-quarter revenue and earnings, supported by increased demand for optical connectivity products used in artificial intelligence data centres.

items.title: Qualcomm, AppLovin, Snap, Arm, Sony, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: Qualcomm tumbles as investors fret about soft chip-design margins, while Sony rises thanks to Spider-Man’s strong return to the box office.

items.title: Coherent (COHR) Raises Full Year Targets After Q1 Earnings Beat
items.summary: Coherent (NYSE:COHR) reported a sizable earnings beat for Q1 fiscal 2027, tied to demand from AI-focused data centers. Management raised revenue and margin targets for the full fiscal year, citing stronger orders and a fuller manufacturing pipeline. The company highlighted indium phosphide laser technology, its PhotonLink platform, and a long-term agreement with a leading AI customer as key demand drivers. items.title: Why Is COHR Stock Up Over 5% Overnight?
items.summary: Coherent issued an upbeat quarterly report and forecast fiscal 2027 sales to rise over 60%.

items.title: Chip Stocks Feeling Blue After Democratic Party Victories
items.summary: Chip stocks fell to their lowest level since late April as investors debated the impact of Democratic Party victories in midterm elections.

items.title: Coherent Stock Climbs Back From AI Data Center Doom and Gloom
items.summary: Company CEO Jim Anderson credited growing demand and manufacturing scale for the earnings beat.
